textContent:
1. F is already dead!
2. B is fighting from the side of A and P
3. A to be "Rannbhoomi me mai agar hamara saamna hua to mai nahi sankosh kerunga". 

The leading scene to the Great Paath of Geeta: 
1. both A and B are fighting each other while parallely both Arjuna and Karna are fighting and the only words are spoken are by THE Krishna!
2. This is the conversation between Prince Arjuna and Lord Krishna!
3. In the end B dies and A holds his enemy in the field and a friend of the lifetime in his hands crying his lungs out and decides to kill himself or someone else maybe V kills him from behind!
4. The same cycle repeats itself and P kills V with all the pain and anger in his heart seeing his only son dieing in front of his eyes. 
5. P also cries out loud while holding his son. Knees touching ground looking for the gods to answer his prayers. Eyes full of tiers looking for a hope in the skies and then SUDDENLY THE TIME Starts to Slow down untill it eventually stops. 
6. In front of his eyes was a god in his actual true form facing the young prince. 
7. Giving the most valuable lesson in the world. 
8. Along with Arjun P also watches that moment, a single moment that contains the knowledge of everything! 

*****Error and correction: It was the first day of the battlefield! not within the fight or the fight with Karna! It was even before the fight had started so will have to tweak the story a bit either at the same time or on Day 11 when Sanjaya Narrated it to Dhritrashtra!
• P notices on the first day of the battle that something has changed in Arjuna's eyes within a moment. Previously it was filled with confusion, fear and seemed without will but suddenly it has will, determination in it! He gets a flashback of him giving A the Bhagwad geeta but could not understands anything!
• But when A dies in that moment he questions why do we have to be here to die, why did we even start fight and die! He could not comprehend! and then he looks at Arjuna and for the first time he takes a glimps of Krishna, the divine himself in a godly form! And he remembers everything and what actually happened in that moment to Arjuna why he was changed just after the path.. He sees it all, The entire Paath of Gita and then he starts to run lifts his sword and everything around him dissapears.. when he looks at the cosmos with a greater perspective He was in shock and fear both at the same time. 
• THIS IS WHEN THE OG A appears and guids him in his journey ahead. It was OG A who helps P to see the Geeta vision because P has read it already in the other worlds!
• It was P who tells the tail of the OG A and all his other worldly adventure and how he never gets to pass the test so he sets the pieces for others to walk on that path and pass the test as he realises that he was never meant to pass it. 
• It was A himself who sends everyone in the current A's way, some to guide him like P and some to make him stronger and fight him! 

Solution: 
1. P watches the entirety of the moment when Geeta was spoke by Krishna but could not comprehend it or understand it at the moment but when his son dies in the battlefield he starts to get the visuals of that moment and just what he needed from the entire paath comes to him hence he CRACKS the code! 
2. As soon as B, A and V dies and he trumbles he was touched by the OG A in answer to his prayers! This will be revealed later in the story when OG A's after the final incident takes place!

After Geeta:
1. P clears his eyes put his son down and lifts his sword and runs as fast as he can until the world around him dissapears and only he remains!
2. A scene leading to how P became the most powerfull supereme of all! (After the OG A <in the past> and the future A)!

This scene can lead in this way: 
1. He actually sees the cosmos and when he opens up his perspective he sees the shape of vishnu in front of him until he was into one of the earths/worlds vishnu creating with his devine breath!
